moments.title: UK Singles Chart #1 Battle
moments.blurb: The Official UK Singles Chart is announced today, with Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' and Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' in a tight race for the top spot.

angles.name: Chart Countdown Excitement
angles.copy: Who's taking the top spot? The Official UK Singles Chart is announced today and it's a nail-biter between Shakira & Burna Boy and Sam Fender & Olivia Dean. Tune in to find out!

angles.name: Pop vs Indie Showdown
angles.copy: Pop power vs indie anthems! Shakira & Burna Boy's 'Dai Dai' is battling Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' for UK No.1. Which track are you backing?

moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Heats Up
moments.blurb: The Hundred cricket competition continues across the UK, with Welsh Fire, Birmingham Phoenix, and London Spirit among teams in action this weekend.

angles.name: Cricket Weekend
angles.copy: Ready for a weekend of rapid-fire cricket? The Hundred is in full swing with matches across the UK. Grab your bat, ball, and best cheer!

angles.name: Welsh Fire in Action
angles.copy: Our very own Welsh Fire are battling it out in The Hundred this weekend! Get behind the team as they light up the pitch.

moments.title: Premier League Pre-Season Friendlies
moments.blurb: Premier League clubs are deep into their pre-season schedules, with high-profile friendlies continuing throughout the weekend and into next week as teams prepare for the 2026/27 season.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The Premier League season is just weeks away, and pre-season friendlies are in full swing! Who are you most excited to see in action this weekend?

angles.name: Club Match Previews
angles.copy: Chelsea vs Spurs, Liverpool vs Leeds, Man Utd vs Atletico Madrid – big pre-season clashes are happening! Get ready for a taste of the new season.

moments.title: Sidmouth Folk Festival Kicks Off
moments.blurb: The Sidmouth Folk Festival, a beloved annual event, begins today in Devon and runs until August 7th, featuring a week of traditional and contemporary folk music.

angles.name: Folk Fest Fun
angles.copy: The Sidmouth Folk Festival is officially underway! Seven days of incredible music, dance, and community spirit in the heart of Devon. Who's heading down?

angles.name: Devon's Musical Heart
angles.copy: Sidmouth is alive with the sound of folk! The annual festival brings a fantastic lineup and vibrant atmosphere to Devon until August 7th.

moments.title: Rum & Reggae Night in Exeter
moments.blurb: Exeter Phoenix hosts a Rum & Reggae night tomorrow, August 1st, promising feel-good summer vibes with Caribbean flavours and live music.

angles.name: Exeter's Reggae Party
angles.copy: Get ready for some serious summer vibes! Exeter Phoenix has a Rum & Reggae night tomorrow. Who's joining for a taste of the Caribbean?

moments.title: Remembering Coolio
moments.blurb: Grammy-winning rapper Coolio, known for 'Gangsta's Paradise' and 'Fantastic Voyage,' would have been 63 tomorrow, August 1st.

angles.name: Coolio's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Coolio, who would have been 63 tomorrow. His impact on 90s hip-hop and pop culture is undeniable. What's your favourite Coolio track?

moments.title: Happy 67th to Joe Elliott
moments.blurb: Def Leppard frontman Joe Elliott turns 67 tomorrow, August 1st, continuing to rock stages worldwide with his iconic voice.

angles.name: Rock Legend Turns 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday tomorrow to Def Leppard's legendary frontman, Joe Elliott! Still bringing the thunder to rock fans everywhere.

moments.title: Chuck D Turns 66
moments.blurb: Public Enemy co-founder and hip-hop icon Chuck D celebrates his 66th birthday tomorrow, August 1st, a true pioneer of conscious rap.

angles.name: Hip-Hop Icon's Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday tomorrow to the one and only Chuck D of Public Enemy! A voice that defined a generation in hip-hop.

moments.title: Happy 34th to Charli XCX
moments.blurb: Pop sensation and innovative artist Charli XCX turns 34 on August 2nd, known for hits like 'Boom Clap' and 'Speed Drive'.

angles.name: Pop Star's Big Day
angles.copy: Happy 34th birthday to the visionary Charli XCX on August 2nd! From 'Boom Clap' to pushing pop boundaries, she's unstoppable.

angles.name: Charli's Impact
angles.copy: Celebrating Charli XCX's 34th birthday on Sunday! An artist who consistently reinvents pop music and keeps us dancing. What's your favourite Charli track?

moments.title: Butch Vig Turns 71
moments.blurb: Drummer for Garbage and acclaimed producer Butch Vig, who worked on Nirvana's 'Nevermind,' celebrates his 71st birthday on August 2nd.

angles.name: Producer Legend
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday this Sunday to Butch Vig! The man behind the drums for Garbage and the production desk for some of the biggest albums ever, including Nirvana's 'Nevermind'.

moments.title: James Hetfield Turns 63
moments.blurb: Metallica frontman James Hetfield celebrates his 63rd birthday on August 3rd, a true icon of heavy metal music.

angles.name: Metal God's Birthday
angles.copy: Raise your horns! James Hetfield of Metallica turns 63 on Monday! A living legend of metal.

moments.title: Happy 68th to Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, the mastermind behind The Lightning Seeds, turns 68 on August 4th, known for indie-pop anthems like 'Three Lions' and 'Lucky You'.

angles.name: Lightning Seeds Birthday
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds on August 4th! The man behind some truly iconic indie-pop tunes.

moments.title: Pat Smear Turns 67
moments.blurb: Legendary guitarist Pat Smear, known for his work with Foo Fighters, Nirvana, and The Germs, celebrates his 67th birthday on August 5th.

angles.name: Rock's Unsung Hero
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the one and only Pat Smear on August 5th! From The Germs to Nirvana to Foo Fighters, a true punk rock and grunge legend.

moments.title: Geri Halliwell Turns 54
moments.blurb: Spice Girls icon Geri Halliwell-Horner celebrates her 54th birthday on August 6th, forever known as Ginger Spice.

angles.name: Spice Girl's Big Day
angles.copy: Girl Power! Wishing a very Happy 54th Birthday to Geri Halliwell-Horner on August 6th! Forever our iconic Ginger Spice.

moments.title: Bruce Dickinson Turns 68
moments.blurb: Iron Maiden's legendary frontman, Bruce Dickinson, celebrates his 68th birthday on August 7th, a true titan of heavy metal.

angles.name: Maiden's Voice
angles.copy: Scream for me, August 7th! Happy 68th birthday to the incredible Bruce Dickinson of Iron Maiden! What's your favourite Maiden anthem?

moments.title: The Edge Turns 65
moments.blurb: U2's iconic guitarist, The Edge, celebrates his 65th birthday on August 8th, known for his distinctive guitar sound and innovative effects.

angles.name: U2's Guitar Maestro
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to U2's legendary guitarist, The Edge, on August 8th! His unique sound has shaped decades of music. What's your favourite Edge riff?

moments.title: Suzanne Vega Turns 67
moments.blurb: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Suzanne Vega, known for hits like 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner', celebrates her 67th birthday on August 10th.

angles.name: Folk-Pop Icon
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the brilliant Suzanne Vega on August 10th! The voice behind 'Luka' and 'Tom's Diner' continues to captivate.

moments.title: UK Summer Holidays in Full Swing
moments.blurb: School summer holidays are well underway across England and Wales, typically running until the end of August, bringing peak travel and family activities.

angles.name: Summer Fun
angles.copy: It's officially peak summer holiday season across the UK! What are your plans for soaking up the sun and making memories?

angles.name: Family Getaways
angles.copy: Kids are off school and the roads are busy! Are you heading for a staycation or venturing further afield this summer?

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Approaches
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, Cornwall's surf and music extravaganza, takes place next week from August 7th-9th, featuring a packed lineup and beach vibes.

angles.name: Cornwall's Biggest Party
angles.copy: Get ready, Cornwall! Boardmasters is just around the corner, August 7th-9th. Who's excited for epic surf, music, and beach festival fun?

moments.title: Good Vibrations Society Festival
moments.blurb: The Good Vibrations Society Festival, a woodland music and wellbeing event in East Sussex, is happening this weekend, July 31st - August 2nd.

angles.name: Wellbeing Festival
angles.copy: Looking for good vibes this weekend? The Good Vibrations Society Festival is on in East Sussex, blending music, wellness, and nature. Sounds blissful!

moments.title: Palace Bowl Concert Series
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series continues in Crystal Palace, London, throughout August, featuring a lineup of iconic artists including Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and Lenny Kravitz.

angles.name: London's Summer Gigs
angles.copy: London, get ready! The Palace Bowl Presents series is bringing huge names like Tom Jones, Gary Numan, and Lenny Kravitz to Crystal Palace throughout August.

angles.name: Iconic Artists in London
angles.copy: From legends to modern favourites, the Palace Bowl in Crystal Palace is the place to be for live music this summer. Who are you seeing?

moments.title: Exeter's National Night Out
moments.blurb: Exeter is hosting its National Night Out event on Tuesday, August 4th, in Downtown Exeter, promoting community connection with free activities and public safety engagement.

angles.name: Community Fun
angles.copy: Mark your calendars, Exeter! Tuesday, August 4th is National Night Out in Downtown Exeter – a fantastic evening of community fun, games, and connecting with local public safety.

moments.title: Guildhall Live: 50 Years of Music
moments.blurb: Guildhall Shopping Exeter celebrates its 50th birthday with a free three-day music festival, 'Guildhall Live', from August 29th-31st, featuring tribute acts and local talent.

angles.name: Exeter's Big Birthday Bash
angles.copy: Save the date, Exeter! Guildhall Shopping is turning 50, and they're throwing a FREE three-day music festival, Guildhall Live, over the August Bank Holiday weekend (Aug 29-31). Get ready for tributes and local talent!
